title: Tides of Blessing
medium: Mixed media textured artwork with metallic gold finishing
description: This artwork expresses the essence of Alhamdulillah — a phrase of deep gratitude and appreciation to Allah for all blessings. Flowing ocean-blue textures represent calmness, depth, and the endless nature of gratitude, while golden calligraphy symbolizes the divine beauty and light of thankfulness.

title: The Throne of Light
description: The Throne of Light is a contemporary mixed-media artwork inspired by Ayat al-Kursi, a powerful verse from the Qur’an that speaks of divine sovereignty, knowledge, and protection. The verse reflects the infinite authority of God, whose Throne extends over the heavens and the earth.

title: Multiplied Blessings
medium: Mixed media textured artwork with elegant calligraphy
description: This piece features the powerful Quranic phrase La’in shakartum la’azeedannakum: if you are grateful, I will surely increase you. Calming bluish-grey and white textures symbolize peace, sincerity, and spiritual reflection, while the composition reflects the divine promise that blessings grow when hearts remain thankful.

title: Divine Reliance (or your chosen title)
titleAr: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
medium: Mixed media textured artwork with elegant calligraphy
description: This artwork features La Hawla Wa La Quwwata Illa Billahil Aliyyil Azeem, a powerful reminder that all strength and ability come only from Allah. Silver and grey textures symbolize calmness, humility, and reflection, while the composition emphasizes spiritual reliance and inner peace through faith.

title: Golden Praise
medium: Mixed media textured artwork with metallic finishing
description: This piece represents admiration and gratitude through the phrase Masha Allah — a reminder to acknowledge that every beauty and blessing comes from Allah. The dark textured background symbolizes depth and reflection, while metallic gold calligraphy illuminates the spiritual meaning of the words.
features: Matte black and metallic gold finish

title: Waves of Patience
description: Flowing blue textures ripple across the canvas in gentle, wavy motions, accented with touches of gold that catch the light. The handwritten calligraphy of Innallaha Maa As-Saabireen rests harmoniously within the composition, embodying serenity, perseverance, and quiet strength.
features: Acrylic texture and ink on canvas

title: Promise After Hardship
description: Soft desert-toned textures form subtle arch-like movements across a clean white background, framing the calligraphy of Fa Inna Ma'al Usri Yusra. The composition reflects hope rising through adversity—an elegant reminder that ease follows every hardship.
features: Acrylic texture and ink on canvas

title: Divine Reliance
description: A vertical abstract divided by flowing textures—deep black and gold on one side, warm earthy beige with golden accents on the other. Centered calligraphy of Hasbiyallahu wa ni'mal Wakeel anchors the piece, symbolizing strength, surrender, and unwavering trust.
features: Acrylic texture and ink on canvas

title: Echoes of Dhikr
description: An abstract interplay of shadow and luminous gold forming a celestial flow in one corner, balanced by intimate handwritten Alhamdulillah. A refined piece symbolizing gratitude as a guiding force—radiant, grounding, and eternal.
features: Acrylic texture and ink on canvas

title: Depths of Tawbah
titleAr: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
description: La ilaha illa Anta, Subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin rises in surrender and hope: a moment of repentance suspended between darkness and mercy, where the heart turns inward and finds its way back to Allah.
features: Acrylic texture and ink on canvas

title: Motion of Faith
titleAr: لا حول ولا قوة الا بالله
description: Flowing in waves of black and white, the sacred words La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah rise and fall like breath: a reminder that all strength, movement, and power return to the One source.
features: Acrylic texture and ink on canvas
